tickets.title: Request estate document package
tickets.text:
Subject: Estate planning document request

Hello Nolan Wrenpuddle,

To help keep the financial plan and account records aligned with the current estate plan, please send copies of any available documents listed below:

- Will
- Revocable trust or other trust agreements
- Trust amendments or restatements
- Durable power of attorney
- Health care directive or medical power of attorney
- Beneficiary designation confirmations
- Letters of instruction or executor/trustee contact details
- Any recent attorney summary letter

If another professional should provide these directly, please share the professional’s name, firm, email, and phone number: Attorney Celia Thimblefern may have prepared a binder after Carla Wrenpuddle’s death; please confirm what was finalized and share her contact details.

Preferred secure delivery method: [secure portal / encrypted email / mail / other: ________]
Documents already on file: 2014 revocable trust and will
Documents still needed: Any later trust restatement, trustee acceptance language, durable power of attorney, health care directive, and attorney summary letter

Thank you,
Apricot Compass Advisory
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the current estate document package by 2026-02-19.

tickets.title: Resolve IRA beneficiary inconsistency
tickets.text: Address the Roth IRA beneficiary record at the custodian, which still lists the 2014 revocable trust as sole beneficiary, while the traditional IRA lists Lena Wrenpuddle and Oscar Wrenpuddle equally. Confirm with Nolan Wrenpuddle whether both retirement accounts should pass directly to his children or whether there is a specific reason to keep the trust on the Roth IRA.
tickets.evidence: Further follow-up is needed by 2026-02-26 on the IRA beneficiary inconsistency, because Nolan expected both retirement accounts to pass directly to his children unless there was a specific reason to keep the trust on one account.

tickets.title: Review successor trustee sequence and authority evidence
tickets.text: Review the revocable trust's successor trustee sequence for Nolan Wrenpuddle, where his late spouse Carla Wrenpuddle remains ahead of his sister Priya Nettlewhisk. Determine whether Priya signed any trustee acceptance and whether another child should be added later, and document the authority evidence needed for any future trust account administration steps.
